scripts._comment_test: --test-concurrency=1 is REQUIRED, not a tuning knob: api-auth.test.ts and payment-route.test.ts each spawn `next dev` in this same directory, and two dev servers sharing one .next build directory collide. Both files skip themselves without a configured .env.local, so this was invisible until a real project was pointed at them. Serial is also ~8x faster here, because the parallel runs were thrashing. --test-timeout covers the server startup those two wait on.
